(COMELEC Resolution No 99 dated 05 January 2007) It bears to emphasize that the mod r manner of entering into government service, whether by appointment or by election, is separate and distinct from the nature of the office bbi g held by a public official, whether it is appointive or elective office/pos ti n. Corollarily, Article 71 of the Impleme t ng Rules and Regulations of the Local Government Code provides that h elective official in cities are the City Mayor, City Vice Mayor and the embers of the Sangguniang Panlungsod. Taking into account the foregoi g premises, we are of the considered view that Section 66 of the nibus Election Code cannot apply to the case of appointed City Coun il rs of Pasay City, the reason being that while their entry into the go e nment service was through appointment as it was the manner provided o by law in filling vacancies in the Sangguniang Panlungsod, the fact rem?i s that they are not holding a public appointive office or position but electiv positions. On the other hand, their being City Cou cilors chosen in the manner provided for under Section 45 of the Loca overnment Code make them fall under the category of elective officials i ities pursuant to Article 71 of the Implementing Rules and Regulations f he Local Government Code.
